<script setup lang="ts">
// <Scatter3DChart>: three customer segments as point clouds (columns of
// x, y, z); drag to rotate, Ctrl / ⌘ + wheel to zoom, double-click to
// reset the camera.
import { computed } from "vue";
import { useI18n } from "minerva-design/vue";
import { Scatter3DChart } from "minerva-design/vue/charts";

const TEXT = {
  en: {
    segments: ["Students", "Professionals", "Retirees"],
    axes: ["Age", "Income (k€)", "Spending (k€)"],
  },
  zh: {
    segments: ["学生", "职场人士", "退休人员"],
    axes: ["年龄", "收入（千欧元）", "消费（千欧元）"],
  },
  ja: {
    segments: ["学生", "社会人", "退職者"],
    axes: ["年齢", "収入（千ユーロ）", "支出（千ユーロ）"],
  },
  fr: {
    segments: ["Étudiants", "Actifs", "Retraités"],
    axes: ["Âge", "Revenu (k€)", "Dépenses (k€)"],
  },
};

const fraction = (value: number) => value - Math.floor(value);
// a cloud of 400 customers around a center (age, income, spending),
// generated deterministically, as columns
const cloud = (age: number, income: number, spending: number, seed: number) => {
  const noise = (i: number, k: number) =>
    fraction(Math.sin((i + seed * 1000) * (12.9898 + k)) * 43758.5453) - 0.5;
  return {
    x: Array.from({ length: 400 }, (_, i) => age + noise(i, 0) * 12),
    y: Array.from({ length: 400 }, (_, i) => income + noise(i, 1) * 20),
    z: Array.from({ length: 400 }, (_, i) => spending + noise(i, 2) * 10),
  };
};
const CLOUDS = [
  cloud(22, 18, 9, 1),
  cloud(40, 62, 24, 2),
  cloud(70, 35, 15, 3),
];

const { language } = useI18n();
const text = computed(() => TEXT[language.value] ?? TEXT.en);
const series = computed(() =>
  text.value.segments.map((name, i) => ({
    name,
    data: CLOUDS[i],
    pointSize: 5,
  })),
);
</script>

<template>
  <Scatter3DChart
    :series="series"
    :x-axis="{ title: text.axes[0] }"
    :y-axis="{ title: text.axes[1] }"
    :z-axis="{ title: text.axes[2] }"
    :height="420"
  />
</template>

<script setup lang="ts">
// <Line3DChart>: a trajectory colored along its height (`colorBy: "z"` with
// the color scale, shown in the color bar); the camera turns slowly around
// it (`auto-rotate`).
import { computed } from "vue";
import { useI18n } from "minerva-design/vue";
import { Line3DChart } from "minerva-design/vue/charts";

const TEXT = {
  en: {
    path: "Flight path",
    axes: ["East (km)", "North (km)", "Altitude (km)"],
  },
  zh: { path: "飞行轨迹", axes: ["东（公里）", "北（公里）", "高度（公里）"] },
  ja: { path: "飛行経路", axes: ["東（km）", "北（km）", "高度（km）"] },
  fr: { path: "Trajectoire", axes: ["Est (km)", "Nord (km)", "Altitude (km)"] },
};

// a climbing spiral of 600 points, as columns
const t = Array.from({ length: 600 }, (_, i) => i / 30);
const PATH = {
  x: t.map((a) => Math.cos(a) * (4 + a / 4)),
  y: t.map((a) => Math.sin(a) * (4 + a / 4)),
  z: t.map((a) => a / 2),
};

const { language } = useI18n();
const text = computed(() => TEXT[language.value] ?? TEXT.en);
const series = computed(() => [
  { name: text.value.path, data: PATH, colorBy: "z" as const, lineWidth: 3 },
]);
</script>

<template>
  <Line3DChart
    :series="series"
    color-scale="turbo"
    auto-rotate
    :x-axis="{ title: text.axes[0] }"
    :y-axis="{ title: text.axes[1] }"
    :z-axis="{ title: text.axes[2] }"
    :height="420"
  />
</template>

translationResources.title: 3D scatter chart
translationResources.description: Point clouds in a 3D box you can orbit: hundreds of thousands to millions of points on the GPU, colored per series, per point or through a color scale, with hover picking, legend and color bar. Line3DChart draws 3D trajectories.

clusters.title: Clusters
clusters.description: Three species of an iris-like data set measured on three features: one series per class, and the legend toggles them. Drag to rotate, Shift + drag to pan, double-click to reset.

galaxy.title: 1,000,000 stars
galaxy.description: A barred spiral galaxy of one million stars generated with a seeded random generator: a warm bulge, logarithmic arms of young blue stars and pink HII regions, dark dust lanes on their inner edge, a thin disk and a faint halo. Each star gets a black-body color through a 0xRRGGBB color column; pointStyle "glow" and blend "additive" make dense regions shine, and exposure scales that light, tone mapped so that the core saturates without turning white. The legend toggles the populations.

color-by-value.title: Color by value
color-by-value.description: Warehouse sensors: the color shows the temperature (value column, colorScale "coolwarm" and a color bar) and the size the humidity (size column). Hover a sensor to read it.

auto-rotate.title: Auto rotate
auto-rotate.description: A DNA double helix turning at 24°/s with autoRotate. The rotation pauses while the pointer is over the chart, off-screen and with reduced motion; the projection switches between perspective and orthographic.

camera.title: Camera control
camera.description: The preset views call setCamera on the chart ref and Reset calls resetCamera; onCameraChange reports the angles after every rotation, zoom or pan.

trajectory.title: 3D trajectory
trajectory.description: Line3DChart draws the Lorenz attractor (12,000 steps) colored by time with a value column and colorScale "plasma".

renderer.title: Renderer
renderer.description: Pick the backend of the data layer: auto tries WebGPU, WebGL2, WebGL then Canvas2D (CPU projection, decimated) and skips GPUs running in software; onRendererChange reports the backend actually used.

embeddings.title: Document embeddings
embeddings.description: 600 news articles embedded and projected on their first three principal components, one series per topic, with the explained variance in the axis titles. Click an article: onPointClick finds its five nearest neighbours, drawn as an extra series on top of the faded clouds and listed below.

lidar.title: Lidar street scan
lidar.description: About 13,000 lidar returns of a street, passed as typed-array columns and drawn as flat discs (pointStyle: "disc"). The radio buttons map the value column to the height or to the return intensity with a different colorScale, the switch remounts the chart in a dark ConfigProvider, and onHover reads the point under the pointer.

satellites.title: Satellite constellations
satellites.description: Four orbital shells around the Earth, from a low broadband constellation to the geostationary ring, moved every 100 ms by a setInterval cleaned up on unmount (one tick is one simulated minute). Each shell is a series with its own legend entry; hover a satellite to read the altitude, speed and period of its orbit.

portfolio-risk.title: Portfolio risk
portfolio-risk.description: Forty stocks by volatility, beta and annual return, one series per sector, the dot size following the market capitalization. The axes format percentages with Intl.NumberFormat, a click pins a stock and its Sharpe ratio below, and the switch changes camera.projection to orthographic for undistorted comparisons.

Scatter3DChartProps.series: Point clouds: objects, [x, y, z] tuples or typed-array columns

Line3DChartProps.series: 3D polylines (trajectories); NaN coordinates break a line

Chart3DCommonProps.height: Height of the chart (the legend included); numbers are pixels
Chart3DCommonProps.width: Width of the chart; numbers are pixels
Chart3DCommonProps.xAxis: X axis (width of the box): title, range, ticks, format, categories
Chart3DCommonProps.camera: Initial camera (azimuth, elevation, zoom, projection, field of view), also restored by a double click; changing it moves the camera
Chart3DCommonProps.autoRotate: Turns the camera around the box: true at 12°/s or a speed in degrees per second; pauses while hovered, off-screen and with reduced motion
Chart3DCommonProps.aspect: Proportions of the box (x, y, z)
Chart3DCommonProps.box: Draws the axis box: back walls, grid lines, tick labels and axis titles
Chart3DCommonProps.colorScale: Colors of colorBy "z" / "value": a built-in ramp (viridis, plasma, inferno, magma, cividis, turbo, spectral, coolwarm, terrain, blues) or CSS colors
Chart3DCommonProps.valueRange: Values mapped to the ends of the color scale; the data range by default
Chart3DCommonProps.colorBar: Color bar of the color scale (title, format); shown when a visible series uses the scale
Chart3DCommonProps.legend: Legend; shown when several series have a name, clicking an item toggles its series
Chart3DCommonProps.tooltip: Tooltip; false disables it, render replaces its content
Chart3DCommonProps.interaction: Drag rotates, right / Shift + drag pans, Ctrl / ⌘ + wheel and pinch zoom, double click resets, arrow keys rotate; false makes the chart static
Chart3DCommonProps.lighting: Ambient, diffuse and specular light of the surfaces and bars
Chart3DCommonProps.exposure: Brightness of the light of additive series (blend "additive"), tone mapped on WebGPU and WebGL2: dense glowing regions saturate gracefully instead of turning white
Chart3DCommonProps.renderer: Backend of the data layer: auto tries WebGPU, WebGL2, WebGL, then Canvas2D, skipping GPUs running in software
Chart3DCommonProps.palette: Series colors (defaults to the --chart-series-1..8 CSS variables, then the theme colors)
Chart3DCommonProps.locale: Language of the built-in texts (accessible summary, legend announcements, tooltip row names) and of the number formatting; built-in texts in English, Chinese, Japanese and French. Defaults to the page language (<html lang>), then the browser language
Chart3DCommonProps.labels: Overrides of the built-in texts of the locale (see Chart3DLabels)
Chart3DCommonProps.onHover: Called when the hovered point, cell or bar changes
Chart3DCommonProps.onPointClick: Called when a point, cell or bar is clicked
Chart3DCommonProps.onCameraChange: Called after the user rotated, zoomed, panned or reset the camera
Chart3DCommonProps.onRendererChange: Called with the backend once it is ready (and after a fallback)
Chart3DCommonProps.ref: Imperative handle: resetCamera, getCamera, setCamera, getRenderer, getInstance

Chart3DHandle.resetCamera: Restores the camera of the camera prop
Chart3DHandle.setCamera: Moves the camera (any of azimuth, elevation, zoom, pan, projection)
Chart3DHandle.getRenderer: Backend in use, null until ready
Chart3DHandle.getInstance: The underlying engine instance (createChart3D of minerva-design/charts/core)

Scatter3DSeries.type: Set by the components; series without a type are scatter series
Scatter3DSeries.data: The points: objects, [x, y, z] tuples or columns (typed arrays are used as is, NaN skips a point)
Scatter3DSeries.pointSize: Dot diameter in CSS pixels (a per-point size wins)
Scatter3DSeries.colorBy: Source of the colors: "series", or "z" / "value" through the color scale
Scatter3DSeries.perspectiveSize: Scales the dots with their distance (perspective projection only)
Scatter3DSeries.pointStyle: Look of the dots: "sphere" (shaded balls), "disc" (flat anti-aliased discs) or "glow" (soft discs with a gaussian halo, for stars and dense clouds)
Scatter3DSeries.blend: "additive" accumulates the light of the dots (dense regions get brighter, meant for dark backgrounds; no depth sorting needed) instead of "normal" alpha blending

Line3DSeries.colorBy: Source of the color; "z" and "value" draw a gradient along the line
Line3DSeries.pointSize: Diameter of a dot drawn at every vertex (0: no dots)

Chart3DSeriesBase.name: Name shown in the legend and the tooltip
Chart3DSeriesBase.color: Series color (any CSS color, var(--x) included); the palette when omitted
Chart3DSeriesBase.hidden: Hides the series (it stays in the legend)
Chart3DSeriesBase.format: Formats the value (or the height) of the hovered item in the tooltip

Chart3DPoint.size: Diameter of the dot in CSS pixels
Chart3DPoint.color: Color of the dot; wins over the series color and the color scale
Chart3DPoint.value: Value mapped to the color scale (colorBy "value")
Chart3DPoint.label: Text shown in the tooltip

Chart3DColumnData.value: Per-point values mapped to the color scale
Chart3DColumnData.label: Per-point texts shown in the tooltip

Chart3DAxisOptions.title: Axis title

Chart3DAxisOptions.max: Upper bound; computed from the data when omitted
Chart3DAxisOptions.categories: Category names (x / y axes of bar charts); collected from the data when omitted
Chart3DAxisOptions.format: Formats a tick or tooltip value (category axes: the category index)
Chart3DAxisOptions.grid: Draws grid lines at the ticks on the walls of the box
Chart3DAxisOptions.visible: Shows the tick labels and the title
Chart3DAxisOptions.nice: Rounds the automatic range to tick values

Chart3DCameraOptions.azimuth: Horizontal angle in degrees, counterclockwise seen from above (0 looks along the y axis)

Chart3DCameraOptions.zoom: Zoom: 1 fits the box, 2 shows it twice as large

Chart3DInteractionOptions.wheel: Wheel zoom: only with Ctrl / ⌘ and trackpad pinch ("modifier") or always
